# ANALYSIS: VALIDATE_WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE_ON_J_ANCHORS

**Filed:** 2026-08-31  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** validation_proposal  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE candidate (applying the same directional signal at 1DTE or 2DTE instead of 0DTE) will preserve the edge_capture on the J anchor days (the 3 winner and 3 loser days that define OP-16) while improving the Sharpe ratio due to reduced theta decay and better risk-adjusted returns.

## Mechanism

We will run a walk-forward out-of-sample (OOS) backtest and real-fills replay on the J anchor days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04, 5/05, 5/06, 5/07) for the WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE candidate. The candidate uses the same signal generation as the base engine (which is the v14_enhanced engine) but overrides the DTE to 1 or 2 days (weekly options) while keeping the same strike selection (ITM-2) and exit rules (-8%/+30%). We will measure the edge_capture (sum of engine P&L on J winners minus sum of max(0, engine loss on J losers)) and the aggregate Sharpe ratio over the OOS window.

## Pre-merge gate

The validation must pass:
- OOS walk-forward test on the J anchor days showing edge_capture >= 771 and Sharpe ratio stable (not degrading) compared to the baseline.
- Real-fills check on the top 3 J anchor days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) showing that the simulated P&L matches real OPRA fills within ±20%.
- The candidate must not introduce any regressions on non-J anchor days (to be checked in a separate full OOS backtest, but the gate for this analysis is focused on the J anchor days as per OP-16).

## Confidence

3 / 10 -- We have not yet run the OOS walk-forward or real-fills on the J anchor days for this candidate. The leaderboard shows promising OOS exp/tr for the general signal pop, but we lack anchor-day-specific validation.

## Pre-existing leaderboard impact

This analysis does not conflict with any existing candidate. It is a validation step for the top-ranked candidate (WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE). If the validation passes, we will promote this candidate to a formal proposal for merging into the engine.
